name: Scallops over Spicy Egg Fried Rice with Snap Peas, Carrots & Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium carrots
1 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Halve snap peas. Add to the bowl with the carrots.
Peel and mince ginger. Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices, then stir-fry until softened, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
toasted sesame oil
garlic powder
black pepper
salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place eggs in a small bowl and whisk to combine.

When the veggies are done, add egg to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until set and no longer runny, about 1 minute. Transfer veggies and egg to the reserved medium bowl; loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Pat scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb sea scallops
salt
black pepper
garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: While the rice is resting, wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add scallops in a single layer and cook until they develop a nice sear and are opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)

When the rice is done, transfer to the skillet along with veggie-egg mixture, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce. Return skillet to medium-high heat and stir-fry until warmed through, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Divide fried rice between plates or bowls; top with scallops and reserved cilantro. Serve with additional chili-garlic sauce on the side and enjoy!
